label: accepted

evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette read instantly as a gem-tipped staff (pointed bulb head, collar ring, flared butt); top view shows a centred gem with 4 evenly spaced prongs; A15 X/Y error 0.0.
evidence.V2: Clear big (long teal haft) / medium (gold claw cup + crystal head, collar ring, butt cap) / small (4 ink grip bands, prong tips) hierarchy.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: flared gold cup with claw prongs cradling an oversized faceted crystal, chunky collar and butt cap, slight haft taper; nothing reads as a stiff primitive.
evidence.V4: Consistent small chamfers catch light on collar ring, cup rim, prong faces and butt cap; grip bands have soft rounded edges; no razor or blobby edges.
evidence.V5: Close-ups show clean smooth shading on haft, cup and prongs, intentional crisp facets on the crystal, no seams, pinches or z-fighting; only mildly polygonal outline on cup rim and collar ring.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one teal hue in 3 values (haft, grip band, crystal) + gold accent + ink dark bands; colourways swap the hue cleanly.
evidence.V7: 1840 tris vs weapon target 2500 (ceiling 4000), at/under target.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material with vertex colours, kit gold/ink/teal palette, ~kit chamfer size; matches the reference kit pieces.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Tool Handle, origin at grip, Hull collision, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Mildly polygonal silhouette on the gold cup rim and collar ring in close-up (low radial segment count); no shading artifacts.
top_fixes: Raise radial segments on the cup rim, collar ring and grip bands to smooth their outlines (budget headroom of ~660 tris).
Optionally enlarge the head slightly relative to the 6.9-stud haft for stronger 64 px read.
